page.layout: One page: a large woodcut engraving of a armillary sphere (celestial sphere) with a small terrestrial globe at its centre, filling most of the page. Its labels are SEPT: at the top, OCCAS: at the right, MERID: at the bottom, and a degree scale 30 to 90 along the upper left arc. Below the engraving, at right, one caption line: QVÁR<. No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: The engraving is a sphere diagram with an inner globe. Its labels, which belong to the figure: SEPT: (top), OCCAS: (right, set vertically), MERID: (bottom), and a degree scale 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 along the upper left arc. Faint show-through text from the reverse side is not transcribed. The caption QVÁR<, printed below the figure, may be a catchword-like or figure label; the mark after it is read as "<" and is uncertain.
